metadata.description: The sharaqi workflow for Claude Code: a cost-aware router. Sonnet runs the session, cheaper agents take bounded work, Opus only on a logged escalation.

plugins.name: sharaqi
plugins.description: Experimental v1.0. /sharaqi do <task>: a prompt hook routes the task from its text (no model call), Sonnet runs the session, cheaper agents take bounded work, and Opus comes in only on a logged escalation (CRITICAL review, checks failing twice, or judgement). /sharaqi route <task> shows the route; /sharaqi go approves a plan.
